paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.03% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+0.73%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.03%). Brent crude changed +1.71% to 111.42. Gold changed -2.99% to 4,035.7. Bitcoin changed -4.33% to 80,372.2578. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.982%, a relative move of -3.00%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+9.92%) and Vale (-8.70%) moved the most.
